milestones.name: Defeat Soul Master
milestones.note: Soul Master guards the Desolate Dive spell in Soul Sanctum

milestones.name: Acquire Desolate Dive
milestones.note: Obtained by defeating Soul Master; required to access many areas

milestones.name: Acquire Shade Soul
milestones.note: Upgrade to Vengeful Spirit found near a Soul Warrior in Soul Sanctum

milestones.name: Acquire Spell Twister Charm
milestones.note: Found in northeastern Soul Sanctum near Soul Master's arena

milestones.name: Save Zote in Greenpath
milestones.note: Knight chooses to save Zote from a Vengefly King; if not saved before Mantis Claw, Zote dies

milestones.name: Save Zote in City of Tears
milestones.note: Zote found in a corridor leading to storerooms of City of Tears

milestones.name: Save Zote in Deepnest
milestones.note: Zote found stuck in spider webs; saving him both times leads to Colosseum of Fools encounter

milestones.name: Defeat Zote at Colosseum of Fools
milestones.note: Final boss of the first trial; grants Rivalry achievement. Zote deals no damage.

milestones.name: Acquire Love Key
milestones.note: Found in Queen's Gardens; key type item, unlocks door of Tower of Love

milestones.name: Defeat The Collector
milestones.note: Found behind the door inside the Tower of Love, unlocked by the Love Key

zones.name: Soul Sanctum
zones.fingerprintHint: Research institution inside City of Tears; contains Soul Totems, Soul Twisters, Follies, Mistakes, two Soul Warriors, Soul Master's arena

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains a corridor leading to storerooms where Zote is found; Soul Sanctum is located here

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Where Zote is first encountered, held in mandibles of a Vengefly King

zones.name: Dirtmouth
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote appears here after being saved in Greenpath

zones.name: Deepnest
zones.fingerprintHint: Zote found stuck in spider webs, presumably captured by beasts of Deepnest

zones.name: Colosseum of Fools
zones.fingerprintHint: Resting area where Zote is captured; he is the final boss of the first trial here

zones.name: Tower of Love
zones.fingerprintHint: Contains a locked door opened by the Love Key; the Collector boss is inside

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.fingerprintHint: Source location of the Love Key

abilities.name: Shade Soul
abilities.note: Upgrade to Vengeful Spirit; found near a Soul Warrior

abilities.name: Spell Twister Charm
abilities.note: Found in northeastern part near Soul Master's arena

abilities.name: Mantis Claw
abilities.note: Referenced as a progression gate; if not acquired before saving Zote, Zote dies in Greenpath

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.grants: Unlocks door of Tower of Love
abilities.note: Key type item; opens door where the Collector can be fought

bosses.name: Soul Master
bosses.note: Leader of Soul Sanctum; guards Desolate Dive spell

bosses.name: Vengefly King
bosses.note: Holds Zote in its mandibles; Knight can choose to save or abandon Zote

bosses.name: Zote
bosses.note: Final boss of the first trial; deals no damage due to shellwood nail; grants Rivalry achievement on defeat

bosses.name: The Collector
bosses.note: Found behind the Love Key locked door inside the Tower of Love
